cues.text: At what level does the aorta pass through the diaphragm?
It passes through the aortic opening.
The aortic opening is at the T12 level.
The azygos and hemiazygos veins and the thoracic duct pass with it.
The inferior vena cava passes at T8, with the right phrenic nerve.
Compare the vena cava opening at T8, and the oesophageal opening at T10.
So the aorta passes at T12.
